notes.title: Athenian Rhapsody Artbook + Manual Release!!!
notes.notes:
[h2]Rhapsodogs - I have something REALLY cool to share with you...[/h2]

I'm releasing an Athenian Rhapsody Manual and an Athenian Rhapsody Artbook!!! Both of these books have a huge amount of content, both for new and veteran players. I've made both of these booklets myself, and I really hope that you, the Rhapsodogs, enjoy discovering what's inside.

[b]Both are available for purchase as a bundle as a DLC for Athenian Rhapsody on the main game page[/b], here are some additional details...

[h3]The Manual:[/h3]
Inside of the manual is a guide towards the game's mechanics, hints towards side quests, tips, tricks, and some general information about Athens and its lore. Discover "Rhapsofacts" which will not only help you with your gameplay, but also enrich your real-life smarts.

[h3]The Artbook:[/h3]
As many of you may or may not know, I actually have a background in traditional drawing, specifically transformational anatomy which I studied before becoming a game developer. In this booklet, I go over the process behind my character creation, how I animate my sprites, why many, many decisions were made artistically and even a bunch of beta renditions of character designs.

If you're interested in Athenian Rhapsody, Game Development, or even Classic/Vintage Video Game Manuals/Materials, this is definitely for you!

Once again, I appreciate all of the love and support I have received for this game from you as a community - I consider myself one of the luckiest people alive because I have the ability to do what I love as a career. In 2025, I will have some amazing things to show you!!!

Also... [i]Thunder Goober Plush are coming soon![/i]

notes.title: Athenian Rhapsody Update v0.96.243 - Bug Fixes, New Armors, and Accessibility!!!
notes.notes:
My favorite Rhapsodogs!!! In this update, I adjusted the game's balance based on your feedback, fixed some small quirks with our first event, and even added some more rewards for it. Check it out!!!

[list]
[*] [b]Adjusted the way player's defenses scale as they level up[/b] - this way players won't feel less powerful as they gain EXP due to healing items becoming less useful in the higher levels... I'm asking for feedback on this change!!! I'd like to balance the game as much as possible.
[*] Added [b]two new armors you can receive from Dynamo[/b] depending on which way you decide to end the battle... That's[b] three different armors total[/b]!
[*] Fixed an issue where you could crash the Dynamo battle during the wire pulling minigame
[*] Fixed the joystick not working during Dynamo's minigame on Mobile
[*] Adjusted the depth of the items you carry during the restaurant scene
[*] Fixed Asmongold not returning to your party when leaving the Event halfway through
[*] Fixed some inconsistencies with certain postmarks/badges when stacked
[*] Added mobile accessibility options in the form of button placement/opacity
[/list]

I am still working on getting SteamDeck achievements working - sorry it's taken so long, as a solodev sometimes it takes me a while, especially when I can't figure out the root cause yet. Though there is no known issue, I suspect it may be a GameMaker runtime issue, I am going to be testing this out to see if that's why as nothing in my code currently indicates that this would be an issue. Sorry!

Thanks guy! Keep playing, I have some more awesome add-ons coming soon!!!

Let me know if I broke anything!

notes.title: Community Items + Small Update!!!
notes.notes:
[b]Hey dogs - I will break this update down into two sections[/b]

[h2]Community Items (woop yeaaaa)[/h2]

You can now collect [b]Trading Cards, Backgrounds, and Emotes from Athenian Rhapsody[/b]!!!!

I will be implementing [b]animated assets too as well in the near future[/b], so be on the lookout for those. I hope you guys go crazy collecting all of the trading cards, all 16 followers + some of your other favorite faces from Athens. It'll probably be easier collecting all of these than it is finding all of the special milk fairies across Athens!

[h2]Update 96.242 (aw boring paperwork taxes blagjh)[/h2]

This is a small update that fixes that strange save file bug some of you have experienced when the save comes up as "Cornball". [i]Let me know if I broke anything!!![/i]

It also fixes a small issue you'd have when experiencing events where checking your mailbox with an event in your storage will crash the game, though your mailbox still would work correctly. This also occurs when going to the main menu. [i]I'm stating this because while it is fixed on PC, it will exist on other platforms but will be patched out likely mid-June[/i], but luckily it's not too bad.

Thanks guys! Go collect some stuff!!!

notes.title: Post-Launch 0.96.24 Update
notes.notes:
You dogs? You're a special kind of dog. You've got that RHAPSO-POWER!!!

Anyways, thanks for bearing with me - here's what's new in the next round of patches, balances, and updates:

[list]
[*] [b]Updated Steam Extension[/b] - what this means is I've updated the way GameMaker connects to Steam, and [b]I'm hoping this resolves the issue of SteamDeck not unlocking achievements[/b]. If a deck player could report if this is true or not, it'd be super helpful!!! Thank you guys!
[*] Aerosol's Meditation skill wasn't working with a full inventory
[*] Fantasma had several dialogue opportunities where she wouldn't say anything
[*] Can still talk to the MilkMan after he [REDACTED]
[*] Spider Boss doing pretend invisible vampire damage to player
[*] [b]BUFFED SCRUT'NHAUS'R!!![/b] Icy Shield now costs 30 instead of 60 and has an extra hit
[*] After battle Richard was spawning some unlucky Cornballs OOB
[*] Added a fail-safe for players getting stuck on the Lore/Story cutscenes in Olympus and in The Cathedral, mostly for Xbox players
[*] Added a [b]FAST-FALL INDICATOR[/b] to platforming sections since many players did not know this was a functionality and in turn got blasted by Goobo
[*] Other tiny, minor little wittle fixes
[*] Chill Mode indicator did not work, instead it showed the player as defeating the Burgizzalard
[/list]

Thanks guys for all of your help with making the game airtight! We are going to be building for console on this current version as well with all of the fixes since launch. [b]Please let me know if I broke anything!!![/b] Lol

Keep showing me your epic Rhapsodies, too!

notes.title: Post-Launch 0.96.23 Update
notes.notes:
Hello you dastardly dogs. You dastardly Rhapsodogs. Who I love very much.

Thank you for playing and enjoying Athenian Rhapsody! I can see through my epic wizard powers that you are all making, stacking, and trading many Rhapsodies! Yippee!!! You've also helped me find some bugs, and in this update I aim to fix many! Please look through them!

And if I messed anything up, [i]PLEASE LET ME KNOW[/i] I did that last time and you guys did, and I patched it

[list]
[*] 3 Stacked Badge shows up as the middle stacked Rhapsody's Badge twice
[*] Forgot to add Dr.Illness to the epilogue, uh, I mean... He was just really hard to find. Made him easier to find.
[*] Horatio's battle basketball minigame should stop not registering shots, if this is not the case check that you're on 0.96.23 and then let me know!
[*] Tundra Badge Guy Goes Away, for real this time (he tricked me last time)
[*] Giga Franklin was showing up as befriended in stacked lullaby Rhapsodies
[*] Richard chase audio cutting out after player death
[*] Inconsistencies with Nylons BURST information
[*] Removed Johnson's mustache
[*] If you play a normal game up to the Fantasy RPG, quit the game in the middle of it, and without closing the game or anything, [i]play the entire game in Lullaby[/i] up to the Fantasy RPG Quest section again, without closing the game, you will get softlocked. You could fix this by closing and opening the game, and I don't know how many people realistically can encounter this, but it's fixed now.
[*] Crabmeat crash when fighting the Burgizzalard. I should honestly have just added his logic in for being a follower but that takes some artwork manpower and I want to fix bugs for you guys first. Maybe soon...
[*] Activating Chill Mode Marker (very tiny, shows up in the Narration, [b]please use Chill Mode instead of complaining online about difficulty its a hard game[/b] there's no shame in it I literally use Chill Mode just to enjoy the game sometimes so I don't have to lock in) shows up as you defeating The Burgizzalard instead. If you used Chill Mode, take advantage of this exploit and flex!
[*] Please use Chill Mode instead of complaining online I literally made Chill Mode the one thing in the game that doesn't make fun of you for a reason so that you use it
[*] Made Cornball's IBS activate your system's smell emitters
[*] Please use Chill Mode
[*] Dying with Swim Gear as Female Cornball crash
[*] Removed Herobrine
[*] Use Chill Mode do not complain online - Thunder Goober
[*] Swimming not working with D-Pad
[*] Fixed The Hero not fighting you if you kill Scrut'nhaus'r
[*] Added Johnson's mustache
[/list]

I'm still working on the Steam Deck achievements thing - I think its a Linux issue, and there aren't really many people I know to ask about this in terms of GameMaker but I'm workin' on it and will have it resolved soon!!!

Thanks guys!

[b]What I'm still working on:[/b]

Through you're help, I'm going to make this game AIR TIGHT!!! It's much different having thousands of you guys run through this game as compared to my few testers, thank you for your patience and help. THOUSANDS of Rhapsodies have been created thus far!!!

I'm so excited to keep growing and building this game... I have new content coming sooner than you think! Stay tuned Dogs!

notes.title: PAX East 2024 + Release Date Following
notes.notes:
[h2]Athenian Rhapsody is attending [b]PAX East 2024[/b] with a [b]RELEASE DATE[/b] following shortly![/h2]

[u][b]Athenian Rhapsody at PAX:[/b][/u]
Like stated in the title, Athenian Rhapsody will be at PAX East 2024 showcasing an exclusive in-person demo featuring the character Uncle Billiard. This demo is only available to convention goers at the moment, and has been designed to be a more immersive and quick experience for the player.

We've also ordered several thousand Thunder Goober hats for attendees to wear around the convention and cosplay everyone's favorite wizard (irritable bowel syndrome sold separately). PAX East is the only place you'll be able to obtain these hats at the moment, and they're made of very sturdy material too so they'll definitely serve as a long lasting pre-launch souvenir.

I also plan to do [b]daily giveaways[/b] of Athenian Rhapsody through digitally redeemable codes which will be sent to winners upon the release of the game - I'm not sure of the exact details yet, but during the show day submissions will be collected and winners will be announced at the end of each day.

[u][b]Release Date Announcement:[/b][/u]
We're just about ready to start our full rollout of Athenian Rhapsody and announce our planned release date to the public - this will most likely be ready within several weeks of PAX East through a brand new trailer. This will be extremely exciting as we have lots of collaborations, content, and exciting things planned for the rollout.

Please stay alert with open eyes and ears after PAX so that you don't miss any new exciting pieces of news from Athenian Rhapsody in regards to release!
